featured.suggestedTitle: Pre-RFC Proposes DNS Domains as Package Namespaces
featured.suggestedSummary: A new pre-RFC proposes using DNS domains as package namespaces in Rust. This approach could provide a more structured and conflict-free way to manage crate ownership and distribution. The proposal addresses potential issues such as crate ownership and namespace conflicts, aiming to streamline how packages are identified and managed in the Rust ecosystem. This could lead to more robust package management and reduced conflicts in the community.

featured.suggestedTitle: Discussion on Alternative Syntax for Async Iteration
featured.suggestedSummary: A discussion on Rust Internals explores an alternative syntax for async iteration using 'for async i in stream'. This syntax aims to simplify the current async iteration model, aligning more closely with other languages like C#. The change could make async code more intuitive and accessible, improving developer experience when working with asynchronous data streams in Rust.

quickNews.title: Rust stack for the smartwatch ESP32-S3-Touch-AMOLED-2.06
quickNews.summary: Espressif has been investing in making Rust a first-class language for their MCUs, like the ESP32-C3 and ESP32-S3. Last year, their esp_hal hit version 1.0 (and was recently updated to 1.1). I wish other manufacturers (looking at you, ST!) would follow their lead. It’s probably only a matter of time before the rest catch up.

Temper 是一个用 Rust 编写的 Minecraft 服务器项目，刚刚发布了初始 0.1.0 版本

项目在 Hyperion 之前就已开始，不是简单的跟风之作

世界生成
自定义地形生成
多人游戏
基础生物（mobs）
简单方块建造

内置 Web 仪表板
自动屏蔽已知扫描器
开发状态与计划
⚠️ 仍处于早期开发阶段，尚不能完全替代原版服务器

quickNews.title: Hylic: Functional recursion crate I just published. Thoughts?
quickNews.summary:
Hi all,
The name's "hylic", because the library helps you formulate hylomorphisms. These are functions that unfold a recursive structure from an atomic value, and collapse that into a result (unfold + fold). The scope of the library is however, more practical and less theoretical in nature 
It's not at all written like the recursion-schemes in Haskell, or the existing recursion crate that already exists: the recursive structure Treeish<Node> is defined external to the Node data structure,…
